fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck driveway off Broome Corporate Pkwy at the NW corner (~42.0446,-75.8141) leading into the secured trailer yard; the SW dock face is set behind a continuous berm/guardrail with no public-road access, and the SE/E and NE yard edges are bounded by undeveloped land, a creek and a stormwater pond, so the NW driveway is the one gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively resolved in overhead imagery at the NW gate throat; z19/z20 tiles over the gate are roof-shifted and parkway Street View (2019) does not reach the NW entrance. Walmart RDCs are typically guarded, but with no visual confirmation guardShack is left false and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis that a controlled truck gate exists but no guard shack is confirmed; low-to-medium confidence, paired with guardShack uncertainty.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved circulation and trailer drop rows immediately inside the NW gate provide ample interior holding before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal yard road from the NW gate to the dock faces easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gate at the NW driveway serves both in and out; entry/exit not separated.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 in / 2 out from the driveway throat width; exact lane count not resolvable from imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and generous paved yard width at the NW entrance leave room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door banks with dock levelers and backed-in trailers confirmed on BOTH long faces (NE face toward the drop yard and SW face along the parkway) over a ~600m building; total well into the 50+ band (estimate ~200 doors).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large striped trailer drop yard on the NE side plus drop rows at the NW corner, hundreds of parked trailers without tractors; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two distinct building faces (NE and SW) consistent with separate shipping and receiving banks typical of a Walmart GM cross-dock RDC.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park in Conklin NY beside the Susquehanna River, surrounded by woods, water and farmland; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad positively identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs N-S along the NE property edge but no spur enters the yard or docks; railServed false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single Walmart building/cluster on its parcel; neighboring DCs (e.g. 101 Broome / Lineage) are separate properties across the parkway, not part of this site.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~68 acres derived from the traced perimeter; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~320 trailers visible across the NE drop yard, NW drop rows and dock faces; approximate count from overhead imagery.
